basis: The blocker reproduced exactly: a manually constructed Pre553IntegrityError and Pre553AuthorityError each minted INTEGRITY_FAILURE and BLOCKED_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY with caller-chosen refs and supporting refs.
No canonical owner-produced refusal witness exists in any owner module, so commission option (1) was unavailable and option (2) was taken.
Both refusal types are bare ValueError subclasses with no fields, confirming that exact type is not provenance.
Trusted refusal state is now derived only from a token-guarded OwnerRefusalWitness produced by a capture that invokes the real competent owner itself.

The exception, producer_ref, supporting_refs and reason parameters were removed from both refusal factories, so a caller cannot independently choose the retained state, the input ref, the supporting refs, or the owner label.

The empirical capture invokes type(original_object), so the owner class comes from a genuine owner object rather than the caller, and all provenance is read from that object's own sealed identity and bindings.
The discovery capture imports and calls the real execute_exact_bounded_discovery itself.
If the owner ACCEPTS the input, there is no refusal: absence of refusal is never converted into a governed state.
The subclass trap remains controlling: refusal_kind gates the mapping so neither witness can be replayed as the other state, and no isinstance classification is used.
The reviewer's stale short-circuited coverage_custody.completeness_state branch was removed; handoff semantics unchanged.
All four R3 gates remain enforced, AT15 genuine ADMITTED route still binds its rule hash, AT16 54/6 remains SUPPORTED, and the eight negative states remain distinct.
208 passed across the ten commissioned suites; no broader sweep claimed.
next_required_action: Narrow independent rereview of C1-03A-R3-REVIEW-BLOCK-REFUSAL-AUTHENTICITY-001, then the Browser/Sol rereview.
